_generated: GENERATED by tools/pool-to-tables.mjs from data/pool.json — do not hand-edit. Edit the pool.
_shape: tables[damageType][anatomy][location] = 12 entry ids. Anatomy is a real dimension: `arm` is a weapon hand on a humanoid and a foreleg on a beast, and the two ladders diverge from row 1. Location is a dimension only for bludgeoning/piercing/slashing; every other damage type rolls no hit location and keeps one `general` table per anatomy.
_placement: Rows are assigned by NEAREST RANK, not by exact match — a rank-6 effect fills row 7 when nothing better is tagged for that table. See content/COVERAGE.md for per-table drift.
_mortal: The 13+ addendum — read ON TOP of row 12, not instead of it. Two halves keyed by different axes: mortal.byPart[anatomy][location] for the weapon damage types (damage-type agnostic), mortal.byDamageType[damageType] for the rest (anatomy agnostic). Authored in content/mortal.md.

entries.name: Appendage Severed
entries.note: The limb is cut away entirely. 2d6 bleed (or the creature's equivalent) stopped by a DC 20 Heal check or magical healing; every attack and ability that used it is lost until regenerated. A failed save leaves you unconscious and dying.

entries.name: Arm Torn Away
entries.note: The arm is severed at the shoulder. 2d6 bleed that a DC 20 Heal check or any magical healing stops; the limb is gone short of regeneration. On a failed save you die of shock rather than of the wound.

entries.name: Blasted Apart
entries.note: Pure force does not burn or cut, it simply removes what it passes through. On a failed save you die at once and there is no body to recover — a raise fails, a resurrection does not. On a success you are unconscious, dying, and permanently drained 1d4 Con.

entries.name: Broken Ankle
entries.note: Broken Ankle condition: -2 AC, speed halved, cannot run or charge, disadvantage on footwork skills. DC 15 Heal, 15 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Arm
entries.note: Broken Arm condition: -6 on attacks and skills using that arm. DC 10 Heal, 10 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Back
entries.note: Broken Back condition: no movement, -4 attack and AC. DC 15 Heal, 30 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Elbow
entries.note: Broken Elbow condition: -6 on attacks and skills using that arm. DC 15 Heal, 15 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Finger
entries.note: Broken Finger condition: disadvantage on skill checks with that hand. Two on one hand become Broken Hand. DC 10 Heal, 5 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Foot
entries.note: Broken Foot condition: -2 AC, speed halved, cannot run or charge, disadvantage on footwork skills. DC 10 Heal, 10 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Hand
entries.note: Broken Hand condition: -4 on attacks and skills using it, and DC 10 Fort on each such use or it becomes a fractured hand. DC 10 Heal, 10 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Hip
entries.note: Broken Hip condition: -2 attack and AC, speed halved, cannot run or charge, disadvantage on Str- and Dex-based skills. DC 15 Heal, 20 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Jaw
entries.note: Broken Jaw condition: disadvantage on skills requiring speech, and somatic-component spells require a concentration check (DC 15 + twice the spell's level) or the spell is lost. DC 10 Heal, 15 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Knee
entries.note: Broken Knee condition: -6 AC, speed 5 feet (half with crutches), cannot run or charge, footwork skills automatically fail. DC 20 Heal, 20 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Leg
entries.note: Broken Leg condition: -4 AC, speed halved, cannot run or charge, disadvantage on footwork skills. DC 15 Heal, 15 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Neck
entries.note: Broken Neck condition: paralyzed until healed. DC 20 Heal, 25 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Nose
entries.note: Broken Nose condition and 1d4 bleed. Disadvantage on Cha-based checks. DC 10 Heal, 10 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Ribs
entries.note: Broken Ribs condition: -2 attack and AC, an extra 1d6 nonlethal whenever you are hit, and fatigued until healed. DC 15 Heal, 20 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Shoulder
entries.note: Broken Shoulder condition: the whole arm is useless and rolls involving it automatically fail; hand-only work (Disable Device) may be excepted at GM discretion. DC 20 Heal, 20 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Broken Tailbone
entries.note: Broken Tailbone condition, and the attacker may take an attack of opportunity against you. All rests take twice as long. DC 15 Heal, 15 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Burned to Ash
entries.note: The body cooks through and what is left is not recoverable by anything short of resurrection. On a failed save you die where you stand; on a success you are unconscious, dying, and permanently drained 1d4 Con from the shock and the scarring.

entries.name: Caved Cranium
entries.note: The skull gives way. **No save** — this is instant death. (Alternative if you'd rather keep the save universal: failure is instant death, success leaves you unconscious, dying, and permanently drained 1d6 Int/Wis/Cha.)

entries.name: Cerebrum Destroyed
entries.note: **No save** — this is instant death for a creature whose head holds its brain. One that has no such organ (an ooze, most plants) takes the Ruptured result instead.

entries.name: Compound Arm Fracture
entries.note: Broken Arm condition and 1d6 bleed. DC 10 Heal, 10 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Compound Leg Fracture
entries.note: Broken Leg condition and 1d8 bleed. DC 15 Heal, 15 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Concussed Ear
entries.note: Dazed 1 round and deafened 1d4 minutes.

entries.name: Cracked Skull
entries.note: Stunned 1 round and take 1d6 Int, 1d6 Wis and 1d6 Cha damage (rolled separately).

entries.name: Crushed Chest
entries.note: Crushed Chest condition: ribs driven inward — -4 attack and AC, staggered, 1d6 bleed, and you cannot recover HP naturally until it is set. DC 20 Heal, 30 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Crushed Larynx
entries.note: Stunned 1 round and gain the Crushed Larynx condition: you cannot speak above a whisper and cannot cast spells with verbal components. 20 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Dazing Blow
entries.note: Stunned 1 round.

entries.name: Dead Leg
entries.note: Speed halved and -2 AC until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Dissolved
entries.note: Flesh sloughs and keeps sloughing after the acid is gone. On a failed save you die at once. On a success you are unconscious and dying, take 2d6 ongoing acid damage each round until neutralized or magically healed, and are permanently drained 1d4 Cha.

entries.name: Dropped Item
entries.note: Any item(s) held in the hand of the attacker's choice are dropped.

entries.name: Flung Weapon
entries.note: Weapon is thrown 1d6x5 feet in a random direction.

entries.name: Foreleg Torn Away
entries.note: The foreleg is torn off at the shoulder. Prone, speed reduced to a quarter, and 2d6 bleed stopped by a DC 20 Heal check or magical healing. Natural attacks with that limb are lost.

entries.name: Fractured Heel
entries.note: Fractured Heel condition: -4 AC, speed halved, cannot run or charge, disadvantage on footwork skills. DC 15 Heal, 20 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Frozen Through
entries.note: Blood and tissue freeze solid; the extremities shatter rather than thaw. On a failed save you die at once. On a success you are unconscious and dying, and permanently lose 1d4 Dex — fingers, toes, or their equivalent are gone.

entries.name: Gutted
entries.note: The belly is opened and the viscera spill. 2d6 bleed that a Heal check cannot stop, and you cannot be stabilized while it bleeds. On a failed save you die at once.

entries.name: Heart Stopped
entries.note: The current takes the heart and the nerves together. On a failed save you die at once and cannot be stabilized — only a heal or a raise brings you back. On a success you are unconscious, dying, and staggered for 1d6 rounds if revived.

entries.name: Hindleg Torn Away
entries.note: The leg is torn off at the haunch. Prone, speed reduced to a quarter, and 2d6 bleed stopped by a DC 20 Heal check or magical healing. Cannot charge or run.

entries.name: Hollowed
entries.note: Everything animating the body is drawn out of it. On a failed save you die at once and rise as a wight under the killer's control in 1d4 rounds unless the body is blessed. On a success you are unconscious, dying, and permanently drained 1d4 levels.

entries.name: Kidney Strike
entries.note: Stunned 1 round and fatigued.

entries.name: Knee Capped
entries.note: Dislocated Knee condition: -4 AC, speed halved, cannot run or charge, disadvantage on footwork skills. DC 15 Heal, 10 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Knocked Down
entries.note: Knocked prone.

entries.name: Knocked Out
entries.note: Unconscious 1d4 rounds. DC 15 Fort at the end of each of your turns to wake.

entries.name: Leg Torn Away
entries.note: The leg is severed at the hip. Prone, speed 0, and 2d6 bleed that a DC 20 Heal check or any magical healing stops; the limb is gone short of regeneration. On a failed save you die of shock rather than of the wound.

entries.name: Lost Teeth
entries.note: The attacker may take one attack of opportunity against you. Disadvantage on Diplomacy checks. False teeth may reduce or remove this.

entries.name: Nethers
entries.note: Stunned 1 round, and every ally of the defender in line of sight loses their immediate/swift action for the round.

entries.name: Numbed Arm
entries.note: -2 on attacks and skill checks using that arm until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Off Balance
entries.note: Knocked prone. You may spend an immediate action to stay standing; if you do, you are flat-footed and have a speed of 5 feet until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Opened Up
entries.note: Torn open from sternum to hip. 2d6 bleed that a Heal check cannot stop — only magical healing closes it — and you cannot be stabilized while it bleeds. On a failed save you die at once.

entries.name: Overfilled
entries.note: More life than the body can hold, forced in until it comes apart. On a failed save you die at once. On a success you are unconscious and dying. An **undead** target gets no save at all — it is destroyed outright, and cannot be raised without first being restored to unlife.

entries.name: Ruptured
entries.note: The body cavity is breached and its contents void. 2d6 bleed that a Heal check cannot stop, and you cannot be stabilized while it bleeds. On a failed save you die at once.

entries.name: Shaken Apart
entries.note: The resonance ruptures every soft structure at once — ears, eyes, organs. On a failed save you die at once. On a success you are unconscious, dying, and permanently deafened; a *heal* or better restores hearing.

entries.name: Shattered Arm
entries.note: Shattered Arm condition: the arm is useless, rolls using it automatically fail, and 1d6 bleed. DC 25 Heal, 30 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Shattered Eye Socket
entries.note: Shattered Eye Socket condition: blinded in that eye, and -2 on sight-based skills, attack rolls and Reflex saves. DC 20 Heal, 20 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Shattered Foot
entries.note: Shattered Foot condition: -4 AC, speed 5 feet (half with crutches), cannot run or charge, footwork skills automatically fail. DC 20 Heal, 20 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Shattered Hand
entries.note: Shattered Hand condition: the hand is useless and rolls using it automatically fail. DC 20 Heal, 20 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Shattered Leg
entries.note: Shattered Leg condition: the leg bears no weight — speed 0 without aid, 5 feet with crutches — and 1d8 bleed. DC 25 Heal, 30 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Shattered Wrist
entries.note: Shattered Wrist condition: the hand is useless and rolls using it automatically fail. DC 25 Heal, 25 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Skull Crushed
entries.note: **No save** — this is instant death. A creature whose head is not its seat of life (see the GM note below) takes the Gutted result instead.

entries.name: Slipped Vertebrae
entries.note: -2 attack and AC, speed halved, cannot run or charge, disadvantage on Str- and Dex-based skills. DC 10 Heal or 5 HP dedicated.

entries.name: Stove-In Skull
entries.note: Unconscious and dying, and 1d6 Int, Wis and Cha **drain** (rolled separately). A DC 20 Heal check stabilizes. DC 25 Heal, 30 HP dedicated to regain consciousness.

entries.name: Tail Torn Away
entries.note: The tail is severed at the base. 1d6 bleed stopped by a DC 15 Heal check or magical healing; permanently lose any tail attack, tail-based ability, and 2 points of Dex until regenerated. A failed save means shock, not death: unconscious and dying.

entries.name: Thrown
entries.note: Moved 1d4x5 feet directly away from the attacker. A solid object stops the movement and forces a DC 12 Reflex save or prone; another creature stops it and forces the save on both.

entries.name: Wind Knocked Out
entries.note: Stunned 1d4 rounds. DC 12 Fort at the end of each of your turns to end it early.

entries.name: Wing Torn Away
entries.note: The wing is torn away at the joint. Flight is lost outright; if airborne, you fall. 2d6 bleed stopped by a DC 20 Heal check or magical healing. A failed save kills on impact if airborne, otherwise leaves you dying.
